results.question: Which patient had the highest APACHE score?
results.sql:
SELECT p.uniquepid, MAX(a.apachescore) AS max_apachescore
FROM patient p
JOIN apachepatientresult a ON p.patientunitstayid = a.patientunitstayid
WHERE a.apacheversion IN ('IV', 'IVa')
GROUP BY p.uniquepid
ORDER BY max_apachescore DESC
LIMIT 1

results.question: What is the most frequently prescribed drug in the Cardiac ICU?

results.question: What is the most frequently prescribed drug in the Cardiac ICU?
results.sql: SELECT drugname AS drug_name, COUNT(*) AS prescription_count FROM ( SELECT m.drugname FROM medication m JOIN patient p ON m.patientunitstayid = p.patientunitstayid WHERE p.unittype = :v1 AND m.drugname <> '' UNION ALL SELECT a.drugname FROM admissiondrug a JOIN patient p ON a.patientunitstayid = p.patientunitstayid WHERE p.unittype = :v1 AND a.drugname <> '' UNION ALL SELECT i.drugname FROM infusiondrug i JOIN patient p ON i.patientunitstayid = p.patientunitstayid WHERE p.unittype = :v1 AND i.drugname <> '' ) GROUP BY drugname ORDER BY prescription_count DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: What is the most frequently prescribed drug in the Cardiac ICU?
results.sql:
SELECT medication.drugname AS drug_name, COUNT(DISTINCT patient.patientunitstayid) AS patient_count
FROM medication
JOIN patient ON medication.patientunitstayid = patient.patientunitstayid
WHERE patient.unittype = :v1 AND medication.drugname != ''
GROUP BY medication.drugname
ORDER BY patient_count DESC
LIMIT 1
